All checks pass. Summary:

Built `ExternalReviewPage` (UC5 external-party review screen) at `/negotiation/external/:linkToken`, gated behind OTP verification with a 3-attempt lockout, expired-link handling, and a restricted view showing only the current version's clauses plus a redline/comment panel. Added `lifecycleNegotiationService.js`, `negotiationSlice` store, `OtpVerificationForm`, and the two hooks (`useVerifyOtp`, `useExternalSubmit`).

- Lint, 35/35 tests, and build all pass.
- Visually verified against a local fixture server at 1440×900 — closely matches IMG-8/IMG-9's layout, labels, badges and colors.
- Result written to `.ui-gen/outputs/T-EXTERNAL-REVIEW-PAGE-UI.json` with `status: SUCCESS` and 7 documented blockers (inferred DTO fields for the banner/clause list, endpoints intentionally left out of scope for NegotiationTrackerPage, the single-textarea vs. two-field DTO mismatch, "Save Redline" having no backing endpoint, the EXTERNAL_PARTY role gap in CLAUDE.md, and the client-side-only OTP lockout).
